content: ANDA VAK YETƗLƗNJA VAK KAT GOD WOVIYAGUGA LƗGANDƗ

Mbambala nɨna kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, ngwuk kat njambwi nyan Jisasna sɨmba nɨma kwundimba mbupmat tɨganɨn. Wukngwangat wanɨn. God yelavɨka lɨga maawupmba yetɨ ngwula. Tak ngwuk kat wupma mbutnɨn. Mbambala Godna maawupmba samat yetɨlɨgangwuk. Godna maawupmba aywaa yetɨngwangat wanɨn.
Tat njambwi nyan Jisasna sɨmba ngwuk kat mbutna nyaangɨk kat ngwula maawut ana tɨvɨlɨgandɨ.
Apma vat yetɨngwangat God wandɨ. Yambɨsɨk kwuka yetɨngwa vat kwagalangwangat wandɨ.
Taagwa klangweya vak kat ngwuk kat mbupmat yigowun. Sɨmblan ke klangwa. Lɨ kat kalalaa lɨ kat kwunaka lɨgiyangwuk.
Kwo yetɨga nɨmba god kat vɨlapman nɨmba sɨmblan taagwa klalɨgandi. Nat nɨmba kat ana yelavɨtɨgandi. Ndina maawupmba mɨna yelavɨtaa klalɨgandi.

Wan kavle vapmba yiga yetɨlɨgweyan njwula mbaapma nɨmba kat kavle vat yigiyangwuk. Wan kavle vak kat yiga yetɨlɨngweyan njambwi nyan ngwuk kat wan nɨma vapmba yigiyandɨ. Wan vak ngwuk kat tamba nɨmamba wowun.
Kavle vak yetɨga yambɨsɨk kwuka yetɨvak kat God nɨn kat ana wandɨ. Apma vat yetɨvak kat God nɨn kat wandɨ.
Kɨta nyan wan mbutɨna nyaangɨk kat kai wandeya nɨn kat ana kai waigandɨ. Ndɨ God kat kai waigandɨ. God ndɨna waagan nɨn kat apma vat sɨmogwivak kat kwilɨgandɨ.
Ngwulagwi kɨta mbaapma nɨmba kat woviyaguga alɨ waa ana ngwuk kat pɨlɨwukiyanɨn. Wan vak tamba God ngwuk kat sɨmogwindɨ. Awat sowat woviyaguga alɨ ngwula waa God ngwuk kat sɨmogwindɨ.
Masedonia walɨnja nɨma kɨpmamba lɨga ngwula kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, wan vak ke kwagalangwa. Nɨmamba kwutaa alɨ ngwula.
Yigumba alɨngwula. Ngwutna nda mɨna vɨga alɨ ngwula. Nat nɨmbanala ke vɨga njatndangwa. Ngwutna njɨvwa mɨna yigumba kwuka alɨ ngwula. Wan nyaangɨt tat ngwuk kat mbutna nyaangɨtna.
Wungi vapmba yetɨngweya kwo lɨga nɨmba ngwuk kat vɨlaa kan nɨmba apma vatmba yetɨga nɨmba ndi waa waigandi. Wungi vapmba yetɨngweyan kwanda kwanda kat kwaka ana lɨgiyangwuk.
JISAS YAGA YANDƗ, KIYAA NƗMBA LAAKIYANDI

Kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, kiya nɨmba kat yelavɨtɨngwangat ngwula maawut kwunapmat tɨganɨn. Kwo lɨga nɨmba ndi nglaga lɨndi. Kiyaa nɨmba laakiyaa nandinya kat ndi ana kawiga lɨndi. Ngwut ndinai la vla tɨlangwuk.

Jisas kiyalaa laatndɨ waa maawupmba yelavɨtɨganɨn. God kwondu kwindɨ, Jisas laatndɨ. Jisas laatnda vak vla God wandɨ maa Jisasna mbaapmba lɨga kiyaa nɨmba laakiyandi. Laatndi, God ndi kat kwutaa kaligiyandɨ. Jisas yaiga njɨmbla ndɨnogwinala yaigandi.
Mbutɨna nyaangɨt nɨna angwa nyaangɨt ana ndɨ. njambwi nyana nyaangɨtna mbutɨna. njambwi nyan yaiga njɨmbla kwo lɨga nɨmba ana tata wokegiyandi. Kiya nɨmba laataa tatak wokegiyandi.

Njambwi nyan nyɨnangwutmba lɨga ngaga yaigandɨ. Ngaga yaga nɨma kwundimba wandɨ, ndɨna njambwi ensel nɨma kwundimba waigandɨ. Godna kwuk klalaa vɨlɨtnja vak kwukiyandi. Wan kak wutaa Kraistna yelangɨmba lɨga kiya nɨmba tata laataa wokegiyandi.
Nɨn kwo lɨga nɨmba nɨn kat ndina kwupmba God nɨn kat wandɨ, wokegiyanɨn. Njambwi nyanonala kɨta vat aywaa nyɨnangwupmba yisolaa lɨgiyanɨn.
Wan mbutna nyaangɨt ngwuk awat sowat mbukngweyan kiya nɨmba kat ana nɨmamba nglaigangwuk. Awat sowat ngwula maawut kwunakiyangwuk.
